messages.content: Can you help me prepare for a software engineering interview?

Absolutely. For most SWE interviews, you'll want to practice: (1) data structures and algorithms (LeetCode medium/hard), (2) system design for senior roles, (3) behavioral questions using the STAR framework. Which of these would you like to focus on first?
